entry.title: PostgreSQL Backup Verification and Restore Drill
entry.summary: A four-layer runbook for proving that a PostgreSQL backup is present, intact, restorable, and usable before an incident.
entry.content:
A green backup job proves that a process completed. A recovery drill proves whether the team can restore the right data, on compatible infrastructure, inside a useful recovery window.

This guide separates backup presence, integrity, restorability, and business usability, with practical steps for pg_restore, pg_verifybackup, validation queries, and recovery evidence.

Read the complete PostgreSQL backup verification and restore drill.
